speakers.name: Priyank Kharge
speakers.role: Minister for Electronics, IT and Biotechnology, and Rural Development and Panchayat Raj
speakers.bio:
Priyank Kharge is Minister for Electronics, IT and Biotechnology in the Government of Karnataka. He held the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj portfolio alongside IT/BT from May 2023 until June 2026, when he was allocated Home Affairs and e-Governance while retaining IT and BT. He is a three-time Member of the Legislative Assembly from Chittapur in Kalaburagi district, elected in 2013, 2018 and 2023.

He first joined the state cabinet in June 2016 as Minister for IT, BT and Tourism, serving until 2018, and was Minister for Social Welfare in the 2018-19 coalition government. During his first term he launched the Bengaluru Tech Summit in 2017 and introduced the Startup Booster Kit; the summit's 2025 edition drew more than 15,000 delegates from over 60 countries. His current tenure has included the Karnataka GCC Policy 2025.

Kharge entered politics through the National Students' Union of India in 1998 and held state-level posts in the Karnataka Youth Congress before entering the legislature.
speakers.org_about: The Government of Karnataka's Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T, based in Bengaluru, formulates and implements the state's policies for information technology, biotechnology, electronics manufacturing, animation and start-ups. Karnataka issued India's first state IT policy in 1997, and the department hosts the annual Bengaluru Tech Summit.

speakers.name: Dr. Ekroop Caur, IAS
speakers.role: Secretary, Department of Electronics, Information Technology, Biotechnology, and Science and Technology
speakers.bio:
Dr. Ekroop Caur, IAS, served as Secretary of the Department of Electronics, Information Technology, Biotechnology, and Science and Technology, Government of Karnataka, from August 2023 to October 2025, and is now Joint Secretary in the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India. She is a 2001-batch officer of the Indian Administrative Service, Karnataka cadre.

In the IT-BT department she oversaw the state's technology, biotechnology, startup and science portfolios, including the annual Bengaluru Tech Summit organised by the department. Before that she was Secretary (Budget and Resources) in Karnataka's Finance Department from 2017 to 2023 and Managing Director of the Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation from 2014 to 2017. Earlier postings include Deputy Commissioner of Belgaum, Chief Executive Officer of the Belgaum Zilla Panchayat, Director of Women and Child Development and Deputy Secretary in the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms.

Dr. Caur holds a Master in Public Administration from the Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy, Singapore, and a PhD in Psychology from Panjab University.
speakers.org_about: The Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T is the Government of Karnataka department responsible for promoting the state's information technology, electronics, biotechnology, startup and science and technology sectors. It frames the state's IT, biotech, ESDM and startup policies, supports centres of excellence and incubators, and organises the annual Bengaluru Tech Summit.

speakers.name: Abhishek Singh, IAS
speakers.role: Additional Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY); Director General, NIC; CEO, IndiaAI Mission
speakers.bio:
Abhishek Singh, IAS, is a 1995-batch officer of the Nagaland cadre who served as Additional Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Director General of the National Informatics Centre and CEO of the IndiaAI Mission, Government of India, until March 2026, and has been Director General of the National Testing Agency, Ministry of Education, since 1 April 2026.

During his second stint at MeitY, from October 2019 to March 2026, he was CEO of MyGov, the National e-Governance Division and Digital India Corporation before heading the IndiaAI Mission, the Rs 10,371.92 crore programme for AI compute, foundation models, datasets and skilling. He also served as CEO of Karmayogi Bharat under the Department of Personnel and Training. Earlier he was Principal Secretary to the Chief Minister of Nagaland (2017-2019) and Executive Director of the Food Corporation of India (2014-2017).

He holds BTech and MTech degrees from IIT Kanpur and a Master in Public Administration from Harvard Kennedy School, where he was a Mason Fellow.
speakers.org_about: The IndiaAI Mission, approved by the Union Cabinet in March 2024 with an outlay of Rs 10,371.92 crore over five years, is implemented by the IndiaAI Independent Business Division under Digital India Corporation, MeitY. It funds AI compute capacity, foundation models, datasets, applications, skilling, start-up financing and safe and trusted AI.

speakers.name: Pankaj Kumar Pandey, IAS
speakers.role: Principal Secretary, Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (e-Governance)
speakers.bio:
Pankaj Kumar Pandey, IAS, is Principal Secretary, Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (e-Governance), Government of Karnataka, a post taken up in February 2026. The department handles the digital transformation of governance and the state's data centres, and houses the Karnataka AI Cell set up in 2026 to guide AI adoption across departments.

A 2000-batch officer of the Karnataka cadre, Pandey graduated in mechanical engineering from IIT Roorkee and secured first rank in the Indian Engineering Services examination in 1999. Earlier postings include Managing Director of Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited (2023 to early 2026), Commissioner for Health and Family Welfare during the COVID-19 pandemic (2018 to 2021), Secretary for Food and Consumer Affairs, Chief Executive Officer of the Karnataka Industrial Area Development Board, Managing Director of BESCOM and HESCOM, Commissioner for Employment and Training, and Deputy Commissioner of Gulbarga district. Pandey holds a patent for the swan-neck Group Operating System, which freed pedestrian space in Bengaluru.
speakers.org_about: The e-Governance wing of Karnataka's Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms steers the state's digital governance through the Centre for e-Governance, which runs the State Data Centre and network and the Seva Sindhu citizen services portal with over 2,000 services, and since 2026 hosts the Karnataka AI Cell that guides AI adoption across departments.

speakers.name: Deepak Bagla
speakers.role: Mission Director, Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), NITI Aayog
speakers.bio:
Deepak Bagla is Mission Director of the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) at NITI Aayog, Government of India. He took charge in July 2025 on a two-year appointment, after serving as Managing Director and CEO of Invest India, the national investment promotion agency, from 2015 to March 2023. Under his tenure Invest India supported initiatives such as Startup India and One District One Product and was acknowledged as the world's most awarded investment promotion agency.

Earlier he was a Partner at the UK private equity firm 3i Group (2007-2014), where he raised a fund for public-private partnership projects in Indian infrastructure, and spent nearly two decades with Citibank across Asia, Europe, Africa and Australia, after starting his career at the World Bank.

He was elected President of the World Association of Investment Promotion Agencies (2021-2023) and has served on government committees on infrastructure, fintech, innovation, tourism and healthcare. He holds a BA (Honours) in Economics from St Stephen's College, Delhi, and dual master's degrees from Georgetown University.
speakers.org_about: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) is the Government of India's flagship initiative under NITI Aayog to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship. Set up in 2016, it has established 10,000 Atal Tinkering Labs in schools and 72 Atal Incubation Centres that have incubated more than 3,500 startups.

speakers.name: Seeram Sambasiva Rao, IAS
speakers.role: Special Secretary, Electronics and Information Technology Department
speakers.bio:
Seeram Sambasiva Rao, IAS, is Special Secretary, Electronics and Information Technology Department, Government of Kerala, a post he has held since May 2025. The April 2025 order that moved him to the role also made him Special Secretary of the Environment Department and Director of the Survey and Land Records Department.

An Indian Administrative Service officer of the Kerala cadre since 2012, he has served as Sub Collector, Wayanad; Director, Kerala State IT Mission; Project Director, e-Health; Executive Director, Information Kerala Mission; Managing Director, Kerala Fibre Optic Network; District Collector, Kozhikode; Director of Survey and Land Records; Joint Secretary, Public Works Department; Chief Executive Officer, Kerala Road Fund Board; and Principal Director, Local Self Government Department. He is a board member of the ICT Academy of Kerala.

Before joining the civil service he worked as a design engineer in system-on-chip and VLSI design at Beceem Communications, Bengaluru. He holds a BTech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from IIT Madras.
speakers.org_about: The Electronics and Information Technology Department is the Government of Kerala's nodal department for electronics and IT matters. It oversees the state's IT parks (Technopark, Infopark and Cyberpark), Kerala State IT Mission, Kerala Startup Mission, KFON and other agencies that deliver e-governance and promote the IT industry in Kerala.

speakers.name: Rahul Sharanappa Sankanur, IAS
speakers.role: Director, Department of Electronics, IT, Biotechnology and Science and Technology; Managing Director, KITS
speakers.bio:
Rahul Sharanappa Sankanur, IAS, served as Director of the Department of Electronics, IT, BT and Science & Technology, Government of Karnataka, and ex-officio Managing Director of the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS), from February 2025 to May 2026. In that role he represented the state at technology events and signed the agreement to co-locate embedded world India with the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026. In May 2026 he was posted as Chief Executive Officer of the Kalaburagi Zilla Panchayat.

A 2019-batch IAS officer of the Karnataka cadre, Sankanur secured All India Rank 17 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2018. His earlier postings include Assistant Commissioner, Lingsugur, in Raichur district, and Chief Executive Officer of the Ballari Zilla Panchayat.

He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication from R.V. College of Engineering, Bengaluru, and worked in the private sector before joining the civil services.
speakers.org_about: The Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T is the Government of Karnataka's nodal department for the state's technology sectors. Its agency, the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS, formerly KBITS), implements policies, administers incentives, runs the Karnataka Startup Cell and organises industry events such as the Bengaluru Tech Summit.

speakers.name: Darshan H.V., IAS
speakers.bio:
Darshan H.V., IAS, is Additional Commissioner for Commercial Taxes in the Government of Karnataka, a post he took up in February 2025 to head the department's Service Analysis Wing in Bengaluru. In June 2025 he was posted as Deputy Commissioner of Dakshina Kannada district.

An Indian Administrative Service officer of the 2016 batch, Karnataka cadre, he secured the 48th rank in the Civil Services Examination of 2015. His earlier postings include Assistant Secretary in the Union Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Assistant Commissioner in Sagar, Chief Executive Officer of the Zilla Panchayats of Kolar and Belagavi, and Director of the state's Information Technology and Biotechnology Department from July 2023 to February 2025.

He holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree from Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi.
speakers.org_about: The Commercial Taxes Department is the Government of Karnataka's tax administration for state GST under the Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, and for minor taxes such as professions tax. Headed by the Commissioner of Commercial Taxes with 14 Additional Commissioners, it works through 13 divisional, appeal and enforcement offices and 118 local GST offices across the state.

speakers.name: T Bhoobalan, IAS
speakers.role: Chief Executive Officer, Centre for e-Governance, and Managing Director, KUIDFC
speakers.bio:
T Bhoobalan, IAS, is Chief Executive Officer of the Centre for e-Governance and Managing Director of the Karnataka Urban Infrastructure Development and Finance Corporation (KUIDFC), Government of Karnataka. A 2015-batch officer of the Karnataka cadre, he took charge of the Centre for e-Governance in July 2025 after two years as Deputy Commissioner of Vijayapura district.

His earlier postings include Assistant Commissioner in Bidar and Kundapur, Commissioner of Tumakuru City Corporation, Managing Director and CEO of Tumakuru Smart City Limited, Commissioner of Municipal Administration and Chief Executive Officer of the Bagalkot Zilla Panchayat. In 2019 the Smart Cities Council India named him Best MD and CEO for project implementation in Tumakuru.

At the Centre for e-Governance he oversees state platforms such as the Kutumba integrated family database, Seva Sindhu and the state security operations centre. He holds a BE in Computer Science from Anna University, a master's in taxation and business laws from NALSAR University of Law and an MA in Public Management from Jawaharlal Nehru University.
speakers.org_about: The Centre for e-Governance is a society set up in 2006 by the Government of Karnataka to conceptualise, implement and monitor the state's e-governance initiatives; it hosts more than a thousand government applications and websites. KUIDFC, incorporated in 1993, is the state's nodal agency for preparing, financing and implementing urban infrastructure projects.

speakers.name: Dr. Kushal Pathak
speakers.title_role: Joint Secretary and CISO, Rajya Sabha
speakers.role: Joint Secretary (Systems, Capacity Building) and Chief Information Security Officer
speakers.bio:
Dr. Kushal Pathak is Joint Secretary (Systems, Capacity Building) and Chief Information Security Officer at the Rajya Sabha Secretariat, Parliament of India. An officer of the Indian Postal Service (2000 batch), he was appointed to the Rajya Sabha Secretariat in January 2024 from the Department of Posts, where he was General Manager (Administration and Business Development).

Over more than two decades in the Government of India, Dr. Pathak has led information technology programmes at the Ministry of Home Affairs, the Department of Rural Development, the Department of Posts and the Election Commission of India. His work includes the groundwork for the IT modernisation project covering about 1,70,000 post offices, the GeoMGNREGA geographic information system for assets created under MGNREGA, and the digitalisation of election processes at the Election Commission, including voter registration, mobile apps and EVM security. He has also contributed to a cyber security framework for Commonwealth nations.

At the Rajya Sabha he has overseen digital initiatives such as tablet-based attendance for members and an app for committee meetings.
speakers.org_about: The Rajya Sabha, or Council of States, is the upper house of the Parliament of India. It has up to 245 members, 233 elected by state and union territory legislatures and 12 nominated by the President, and is a permanent house that cannot be dissolved. Its Secretariat supports the House's legislative and committee work.

speakers.name: Meeta R Lochan, IAS
speakers.role: Secretary, National Commission for Backward Classes, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
speakers.bio:
Meeta R Lochan (Meeta Rajivlochan), IAS, served as Secretary, National Commission for Backward Classes, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, from June 2025 until her superannuation on 31 August 2026. A 1990-batch officer of the Maharashtra cadre, she has more than three decades of experience in public administration.

Before NCBC she was Secretary, Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (2022-2025), where she facilitated the launch of the MY Bharat youth portal, which has over 20 million users. She was Member Secretary of the National Commission for Women (2020-2022), Additional Director General of Foreign Trade in Mumbai and Managing Director of Maharashtra Agro Industries Development Corporation. In Maharashtra she helped build a health insurance platform and a drug warehousing and quality assurance platform now used by sixteen states.

She holds a BA in English and an MA in English Literature and History from Punjab University, Chandigarh, and is registered on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs independent director databank.
speakers.org_about: The National Commission for Backward Classes is a constitutional body under Article 338B of the Constitution of India, based in New Delhi. It investigates and monitors safeguards for socially and educationally backward classes, inquires into complaints, advises on their socio-economic development and reports to the President.

speakers.name: Ramachandran R, IAS
speakers.role: Managing Director, Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation
speakers.bio:
Ramachandran R, IAS, is a 2012-batch officer of the Indian Administrative Service, Karnataka cadre, who served as Managing Director of the Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) from January 2024 to October 2025, running a fleet of more than 6,500 buses, and for a period in 2025 also held concurrent charge of the Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation. Since March 2026 Ramachandran has been Director of Census Operations and Director of Citizen Registration, Karnataka, on central deputation, after serving as Executive Director of the Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust, the state health agency of Karnataka.

Earlier postings include Deputy Commissioner and District Magistrate of Bidar and of Bagalkot, Chief Executive Officer of the Belagavi and Koppal Zilla Panchayats, State Mission Director of the National Health Mission, Karnataka, Director of Pre-University Education, Chairperson of the Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board, and Special Commissioner (Elections) at the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike. Ramachandran holds a bachelor's degree in zoology from the University of Madras and law degrees from Dr. Ambedkar Law University.
speakers.org_about: Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation, wholly owned by the Government of Karnataka, has provided Bengaluru's public bus service since 1997. In October 2025 it operated about 7,000 buses, including around 1,800 electric buses, carrying roughly 4.8 million passengers a day, the highest ridership of any city bus operator in India.

speakers.name: Manuj Goyal, IAS
speakers.role: Additional Secretary, Higher and Technical Education
speakers.bio:
Manuj Goyal, IAS, is Additional Secretary, Higher and Technical Education, Government of Uttarakhand, a post held since April 2025. Since June 2025 Goyal has also served as Mission Director of the National Health Mission, Uttarakhand. An officer of the 2014 batch of the Indian Administrative Service, Uttarakhand cadre, Goyal held early postings as Assistant Collector, Sub-Divisional Magistrate and City Magistrate.

Goyal was Chief Development Officer of Almora (2019-2020), District Magistrate of Rudraprayag (2020-2022) and Commissioner of the Dehradun Municipal Corporation (2022-2023). From December 2023 to May 2025 Goyal was Additional Secretary, Rural Development, serving as CEO of the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihoods Mission and Project Director of the Rural Enterprises Acceleration Project, with additional charge as Additional Secretary, Agriculture and Farmer Welfare, and as Managing Director of House of Himalayas (March 2024 to May 2025).

Before joining the civil service, Goyal worked as an analyst at the investment bank BDA Partners in Mumbai (2008-2010). Goyal holds a BTech in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Bombay.
speakers.org_about: The Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand, oversees the state's university and college system, which comprises 33 universities (11 state, 1 central and 18 private) and 3 institutes of national importance, along with 118 government and 21 aided colleges as of 2024. Uttarakhand was among the first states to implement the National Education Policy 2020 in higher education.

speakers.name: Suvendu Pati
speakers.bio:
Suvendu Pati is Chief General Manager at the Reserve Bank of India and heads the FinTech Department at the RBI's Central Office in Mumbai. The department, set up in January 2022, runs the regulatory sandbox, the Reserve Bank's HaRBInger hackathon, the Unified Lending Interface pilot and the framework for self-regulatory organisations in fintech, and is the nodal department for the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub and the Account Aggregator ecosystem.

Pati has been Chief General Manager since May 2021. As General Manager from 2014 to 2021, Pati handled responsibilities in bank and NBFC supervision, foreign exchange management, currency management, financial inclusion, internal audit, and planning and budget. Before the RBI, Pati worked in the purchase function at Ballarpur Industries (BILT) from 1993 to 1996.

Pati holds a postgraduate diploma in forestry management from the Indian Institute of Forest Management and an MSc in Finance and Financial Regulation from Aston Business School, UK, and was inducted into the Beta Gamma Sigma international honour society in 2013.
speakers.org_about: The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank, established on 1 April 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, and fully owned by the Government of India since 1949. Its FinTech Department, created in January 2022, gives focused attention to the fintech sector and facilitates innovation while addressing associated risks.

speakers.name: Sahil Kini
speakers.bio:
Sahil Kini is Chief Executive Officer of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH), the wholly owned innovation subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India, a role he took up in July 2025. He also sits on the RBIH board. At RBIH he leads work on digital public financial infrastructure, including the Unified Lending Interface (ULI), the MuleHunter.ai fraud-detection model and the Digital Payments Intelligence Platform.

Kini co-founded the API infrastructure company Setu in 2018 and was its CEO until 2024; Setu was acquired by Pine Labs in 2022. From 2016 to 2025 he was part of iSPIRT's IndiaStack core team, working on policy for digital public goods such as UPI and Account Aggregator. Earlier he was a Principal at Aspada Investments, managed hardware development at Ezetap, spent a year with the Unique Identification Authority of India on Aadhaar's early operations, and began his career as a business analyst at McKinsey & Company.

He holds a B.Tech in Metallurgy and Materials Engineering from IIT Madras.
speakers.org_about: The Reserve Bank Innovation Hub is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India, incorporated in March 2021 as a Section 8 company with initial capital of Rs 100 crore and inaugurated in Bengaluru in March 2022. It works with banks, fintechs, regulators and academia to build digital public infrastructure for financial services.

speakers.name: Suresh Khadakbhavi
speakers.bio:
Suresh Khadakbhavi is Chief Executive Officer of Digi Yatra Foundation, the not-for-profit company that runs India's facial-recognition-based passenger processing system for airports. Appointed on 1 April 2023, he leads the Digi Yatra Central Ecosystem, built on W3C standards, self-sovereign identity and verifiable credentials, and its roll-out across Indian airports.

Before that he spent more than 15 years at Bangalore International Airport Ltd, which he joined in 2007 as Senior Manager for ICT communications; he later served as Deputy General Manager for ICT and, from 2016, led the airport's Innovation Lab, latterly as Assistant Vice President. The Digi Yatra concept grew out of his 2015 proposal, 'My face is my boarding pass', and a 2017 biometric boarding pilot at Bengaluru; he was a member of the working committee that drafted the Digi Yatra policy and of IATA's One ID advisory group.

His earlier career was in telecommunications, including a radio trunking project for Saudi Aramco with Saudi Bell Group. He holds a B.E. in Electronics and Communications from Karnatak University.
speakers.org_about: Digi Yatra Foundation is a not-for-profit Section 8 company set up in 2019 by the Airports Authority of India (26 per cent) and five private airport operators to build and run the Digi Yatra Central Ecosystem for biometric passenger processing. By May 2026 the service had enabled over 10 crore journeys across 38 airports.

speakers.name: Angela Lusigi
speakers.bio:
Angela Lusigi is Resident Representative of UNDP India, a post she took up on 8 July 2024. She has more than 25 years of experience in socio-economic analysis, national development policy, programme leadership, resource mobilisation and UN coordination.

Before moving to India she was UNDP Resident Representative for Ghana from 2020 to 2024 and, from 2012, Strategic Advisor in the UNDP Regional Bureau for Africa in New York. Earlier UN roles include Regional Programme Advisor to the UNEP/UNDP Poverty and Environment Initiative (2007-2012), Poverty Programme Specialist for UNDP Tanzania (2005-2007), Assistant Resident Representative for Strategy and Policy for UNDP Nigeria (2003-2005). Before joining the UN she provided policy and analytical support to the governments of Botswana and South Africa on behalf of the University of Reading and the UK Department for International Development.

She holds a PhD and a master's degree in Agricultural Economics from the University of Reading and a bachelor's degree in Economics and Computer Science from the University of Waterloo, Canada.
speakers.org_about: The United Nations Development Programme has worked in India since 1951, with projects and programmes in every state and union territory. Its 2023-2027 Country Programme focuses on sustainable and inclusive growth, climate and environment action, health system strengthening and accelerating the Sustainable Development Goals, working with national and state governments.

speakers.name: Vishal Dhupar
speakers.bio:
Vishal Dhupar is Managing Director, South Asia, at NVIDIA, a role he has held since 2010. He runs NVIDIA's business in India and South Asia, including sales, marketing, operations and channels, is the company's point of contact for government, public institutions and industry bodies, and drives the adoption of accelerated computing and AI across enterprises in India.

Dhupar joined NVIDIA from Symantec, where he was Managing Director for India and SAARC and led the integration of Symantec and Veritas in the region. Earlier he was Managing Director of Autodesk India and SAARC, Director of Sales at Sun Microsystems India, and held sales roles at Silicon Graphics and Digital Equipment Corporation after beginning his career at DCM Data Products.

He has been named among MIT Sloan Management Review India's Tech 100 and Analytics India Magazine's AIM100, and contributes to industry and advisory bodies including CII and IDGS. He is a member of the World Economic Forum's AI Advisory Council in India and has served as chairman of the Telangana AI Mission.
speakers.org_about: NVIDIA is a US technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and founded in 1993. It designs GPUs, systems and software for accelerated computing and AI, and reported revenue of US$215.9 billion and about 42,000 employees for its fiscal year ended January 2026.

speakers.name: Sanjeev Rastogi
speakers.title_role: Head, Group Policy Services, Adani Group
speakers.bio:
Sanjeev Rastogi is Head, Group Policy Services at Adani Group (Adani Enterprises Limited). From June 2024 to April 2026 he was CEO of the Adani Group Global Capability Centre, described as India's first multi-industry, multi-functional GCC, which consolidates HR, finance, procurement, IT and analytics services for the group's 900-plus entities across more than 700 locations.

He has over 30 years of experience in global business services and shared services. Before Reliance, he spent six years at Prione Business Services, the Amazon and Catamaran joint venture that helps Indian small and medium businesses sell online. He joined Prione in 2015 as Head of Sales and Chief Operating Officer, became Chief Executive Officer in 2018 and Managing Director and CEO in 2019, leading over 700 employees across more than 150 cities. speakers.name: George Inasu
speakers.title_role: MD and Country Head, Fidelity National Financial India

George Inasu is Managing Director and Country Head of Fidelity National Financial India (FNF India), the Bengaluru-based global capability centre of Fidelity National Financial, Inc., the Fortune 500 US title insurance and settlement services company. He joined FNF India in 2006 and has held roles including Chief Operating Officer and Vice President, Global Operations, before taking charge of the centre, which has grown from about 150 employees to more than 5,000 handling underwriting, operations and technology work for the parent.

Inasu has more than two decades of leadership experience in the financial sector. He is a Six Sigma Green Belt and has received FNF's Leadership Award (2012) and Maverick Award (2015). He speaks regularly on the evolution of global capability centres in India, including AI adoption, culture and talent, at industry forums and in interviews with ET Edge Insights and IMA India.
speakers.org_about: FNF India is the Bengaluru-based global capability centre of Fidelity National Financial, Inc. (NYSE: FNF), a Fortune 500 provider of title insurance and settlement services to the US real estate and mortgage industries. speakers.name: Anand Ramakrishnan
speakers.bio:
Anand Ramakrishnan is Managing Director of Equiniti India (EQ India), the global capability centre of the UK-based share registration, pensions and payments group EQ. He joined in September 2021 and is responsible for the centre's operations in Bengaluru and Chennai, supporting the group's operations, technology and corporate functions in the UK and US. Under him the India unit has grown from about 900 people to around 2,500, more than 40 per cent of the group's global workforce.

Before EQ he was Chief Executive Officer of MFX and Qtek Systems, two Quess Corp IT services subsidiaries, from 2017 to 2021. Earlier he was Chief Strategy Officer, CIO and business unit head at CMS IT Services, Vice President and business head for managed services and cloud at HCL Infosystems, and spent a decade at Wipro, latterly as General Manager and business head for cloud computing services.

He holds an MBA in finance from T.A. Pai Management Institute and a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Bangalore University.
speakers.org_about: EQ India (Equiniti India) is the global capability centre of EQ, the UK's largest share registrar and the second largest in the United States. Opened in 2014, it operates from Bengaluru and Chennai and provides operations, technology, finance and other shared services to the group; it employs about 2,500 people, roughly 42 per cent of EQ's global workforce.

speakers.name: Tulshekar Gangireddy
speakers.role: Executive Director & Head of Data Strategy
speakers.title_role: ED and Head of Data Strategy, JPMorgan Chase
speakers.bio:
Tulshekar Gangireddy is Executive Director and Head of Data Strategy at JPMorgan Chase & Co, based in Bengaluru. Since October 2023 Gangireddy has built the firm's Trust and Safety data team across several locations, designed its enterprise data strategy and self-service data platform, and overseen an AI/ML centre of excellence. From April 2022 to October 2023 Gangireddy was a data leader for the Merchant Services business, leading India data management and global ETL teams of about 130 people responsible for a unified data lake, data catalogue and data governance.

Earlier roles include Vice President of Engineering at PayU (2021-2022), Software Development Manager at Amazon (2020-2021), Senior Engineering Manager at Walmart Global Tech India (2018-2020) and Groupon (2016-2018), Director of Engineering at Cafyne, and engineering management positions at Juniper Networks, Apigee, Yahoo and Akamai Technologies.

Gangireddy has mentored more than 3,500 postgraduate learners in AI, machine learning and data technologies through Great Learning. In August 2026 Gangireddy received the Elets BFSI100 Gamechanger Award for Trust and Data Innovation.
speakers.org_about: JPMorganChase is a global financial services firm headquartered in New York with more than 225 years of history. Through its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands it serves consumers, small businesses and corporate, institutional and government clients worldwide across asset and wealth management, commercial and investment banking and consumer banking, and employs more than 60,000 technologists.

speakers.name: Deepak Mohanty

Deepak Mohanty is Executive Director at Wells Fargo, leading Business Solution Enablement from Bengaluru. Mohanty joined Wells Fargo in November 2024 and brings more than 22 years of experience in financial services technology and consulting in India and the United Kingdom.

Before Wells Fargo, Mohanty spent close to seven years at HSBC in Bengaluru as Vice President. From 2005 to 2018 Mohanty was with Cognizant in London, rising from Senior Business Analyst to Senior Manager, Consulting, with engagements for banks and financial institutions including Credit Suisse, J.P. Morgan Chase, UBS, BNY Mellon, Citi, American Express, Ameriprise Financial, Lloyds Banking Group and Barclays. Earlier roles were as a consultant at Polaris in Chennai and an implementation consultant at Infosys in Hyderabad.

Mohanty holds an MBA in Marketing and Systems from the Xavier Institute of Management and a BE in Mechanical Engineering from Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology, Burla.
speakers.org_about: Wells Fargo is a US financial services company. Its India and Philippines operations, with offices in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Manila, are an extension of the company's technology, operations and corporate support teams, engaging in application development, testing, international operations and middle- and back-office banking process solutions.

speakers.name: Anand Thakur
speakers.bio:
Anand Thakur is Chief Product and Technology Officer at Reliance Retail, where he leads product and technology for the fashion, lifestyle and beauty businesses, including Ajio, Tira, Swadesh, Shein India, Reliance Trends and the fashion and lifestyle supply chain. He joined Reliance Retail as Chief Technology Officer in December 2021.

He has more than 20 years of experience in technology, product and digital roles. Before Reliance he was Group CTO of REA India (formerly Elara Technologies), which runs Housing.com, PropTiger and Makaan; Chief Digital Officer at Jubilant FoodWorks (Domino's India), where he set up the company's digital team in 2017; and CTO of the fashion e-commerce platform Koovs. Earlier he held technology roles at Lenskart, Adobe, Perot Systems and Infosys and founded the start-up EasyRation. He holds a US patent and has authored several publications.

He holds a BTech in Electronics from YMCA Institute of Engineering.

speakers.name: Pawan Sachdeva
speakers.role: Senior Managing Director and Technology Head - India
speakers.title_role: Senior MD and Technology Head India, Carelon

Pawan Sachdeva is Senior Managing Director and Technology Head, India at Carelon Global Solutions, the global capability centre of US health insurer Elevance Health. In this role, held since June 2025, Sachdeva leads technology for the company's India operations, with a focus on agentic AI transformation, site leadership and the workforce of the future.

Sachdeva joined the company (then Legato Health Technologies) in 2018 as Director of Technology and went on to serve as Staff Vice President (2020 to 2022) and as Managing Director, Technology and Gurugram Site Leader (2022 to 2025). Before that, Sachdeva spent more than a decade at UnitedHealth Group in project and engineering management roles in Gurugram and Minneapolis, ending as Senior Engineering Manager (Associate Director). Earlier career stops include Synechron and Reliance Communications.

With more than 20 years of experience in healthcare technology and global capability centre leadership, Sachdeva studied at Manipal Academy of Higher Education (2000 to 2002) and completed a programme on creating high-performance organisations at IIM Bangalore in 2012.
speakers.org_about: Carelon Global Solutions, formerly Legato Health Technologies, is the global capability centre of US health insurer Elevance Health, providing IT, data analytics and business operations services for healthcare. speakers.name: Pranav Saxena
speakers.bio:
Pranav Saxena is Chief Product and Technology Officer at API Holdings, the parent company of PharmEasy, Thyrocare, Retailio, Docon and Aknamed, a role taken up in June 2024.

Saxena spent about a decade at Flipkart, joining in 2014 as Senior Director of Products heading logistics and fulfilment, with responsibility for same-day and slotted delivery, cash on delivery, returns and end-to-end supply chain platforms. Saxena went on to become Vice President of Product and Engineering for consumer experience, headed Flipkart's Centre of Excellence for Robotics and Automation, which launched robotic sortation and packaging in its fulfilment centres, and served as Chief Technology and Product Officer of Flipkart Health+ from 2021 to 2025.

Earlier Saxena held product and innovation leadership roles at SAP Labs in Bengaluru (2007-2014), was a Product Manager at Intel and a General Manager at Reliance Retail, and held product roles at Infosys and JDA Software. Saxena studied at IIM Bangalore and IIT and completed the Chief Technology Officer programme at UC Berkeley Haas.
speakers.org_about: API Holdings, based in Mumbai, describes itself as India's largest digital healthcare platform, operating an integrated business that serves consumers, pharmaceutical companies, wholesalers, pharmacies, hospitals, doctors and diagnostic labs. speakers.name: Suman Guha
speakers.title_role: Chief Digital and Technology Officer, Croma
speakers.bio:
Suman Guha is Chief Digital & Technology Officer at Croma, the Tata group's consumer electronics retail chain run by Infiniti Retail, a Tata Digital company. Guha joined Croma in August 2024 and heads its product management, technology, engineering, UX, data, information security, infrastructure and IT functions, leading AI adoption across functions, migration from SAP ECC to S/4HANA and modernisation of the commerce platforms. Until March 2026 Guha also held a dual role as CTO of Tata CLiQ and head of technology for Tata Digital's commerce entities.

Before Tata, Guha was Chief Product and Technology Officer for Reliance Retail's fashion, sports and Tira beauty businesses (2021-24). Earlier roles include Head of Business Critical Services product and engineering at Cisco, product leader for price, promotions and loyalty at Tesco in the UK, leader of Teradata's IntelliCloud service and Principal at Red Hat in the US.

Guha has completed executive programmes at Stanford Graduate School of Business and The Wharton School, and a MicroMasters in data science from UC San Diego.

speakers.name: Avinash Naik

Avinash Naik is Chief Information Officer of Bajaj Allianz General Insurance, now Bajaj General Insurance, where he holds the rank of President and leads technology and digital transformation for the country's third-largest general insurer by gross written premium. He joined the company in May 2018 as Senior Vice President and Head of Technology and Digital Transformation, became President in April 2022 and was appointed CIO in December 2022. He also served as Head of Digital and Innovation at Bajaj Finserv from 2016 to 2022.

Under Naik, the insurer moved its core policy administration system to the cloud, built an API vault to speed partner integrations, launched AI-based chatbots on WhatsApp and a multilingual voice bot, and began a data platform modernisation programme. Earlier he was Senior Associate Vice President at ICICI Lombard (2012-2016) and spent twelve years at Infosys in India and the United States, rising from software engineer to senior client partner.

He holds a Bachelor of Engineering from the University of Mumbai.
speakers.org_about: Bajaj General Insurance Limited (formerly Bajaj Allianz General Insurance) is a Pune-headquartered private general insurer established in 2001 and a subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv. speakers.name: Harsh Vardhan
speakers.title_role: Global Head, AI and Digital Innovation, Apollo Tyres

Harsh Vardhan is Global Head of AI and Digital Innovation at Apollo Tyres Ltd, a role he took up in June 2023. He leads the company's global digital innovation strategy, covering AI-led manufacturing, supply chain modernisation and Industry 4.0 programmes, and set up and scaled its Digital Innovation Hub in India. Work under him includes enterprise generative AI pilots with start-ups at T-Hub in Hyderabad, an in-house manufacturing reasoning tool and AI-based virtual compounding for R&D.

Before Apollo Tyres he was Chief Digital Transformation Officer for 'IDEA by Capgemini', the firm's data, AI and IIoT modernisation portfolio, from 2020 to 2023. From 2005 to 2019 he was at Cognizant, latterly as Associate Product Director and principal architect of its BigDecisions AI platform, after roles in big data analytics in London and as a data warehouse and BI architect in Singapore, the UK and the US.

He holds a postgraduate diploma in data science from IIIT Bangalore and completed an executive programme in digital transformation at the Indian School of Business.

speakers.name: Vijaya Kadiyala
speakers.bio:
Vijaya Kadiyala is Executive Director for Data, AI, Cloud and Enterprise Architecture at DBS Bank, based at DBS Tech India in Hyderabad. Kadiyala has more than 24 years in technology, including a decade at JPMorgan Chase, and joined DBS in May 2021 as Executive Director for the Data and AI Platform before leading Cloud Engineering (2023-2024) and taking on the current role in December 2024.

At DBS, Kadiyala's teams re-architected the bank's data orchestration platform, migrated more than 8,000 data jobs and 750 TB of data to Google Cloud, and modernised its cloud data platform. Kadiyala has also led talent programmes at DBS Tech India, including generative AI upskilling for around 2,600 employees and a campus programme reaching 10,000 students across 20 universities.

At JPMorgan Chase (2014-2021) Kadiyala rose from Vice President to Executive Director in data solutions, engineering and architecture roles, and was selected for the firm's Expert Engineer programme. Kadiyala sits on nasscom's Telangana Region Council and has written two books published in 2026, including The Conduct Gap.
speakers.org_about: DBS is a financial services group headquartered and listed in Singapore, founded in 1968, with a presence in 19 markets across Greater China, Southeast Asia and South Asia and total assets of SGD 827 billion (2024). speakers.name: Shanmugam Manivannan
speakers.title_role: Chief Digital Officer, Equitas Small Finance Bank

Shanmugam Manivannan is Chief Digital Officer at Equitas Small Finance Bank, Chennai. Manivannan took up the role in June 2026 after two years as Senior Vice President and Head of Digital Channels (Liabilities), has been with Equitas since 2016, the year the bank began operations, and has more than 22 years of experience in banking operations and digital channels.

At Equitas, Manivannan served as delivery lead for the bank's channel build-out at launch, covering the call centre, corporate and retail internet banking, mobile banking, ATMs and debit cards, and later led digital banking, neo-banking, transformation and channels. Programmes under this remit include digital savings and current account onboarding with video KYC, API-based partnerships with fintechs, the 'Banker on Wheels' service, video banking and chatbots for the website and WhatsApp.

Before Equitas, Manivannan spent five years at DBS Bank in Chennai as Senior Manager and Service Delivery Manager for contact centre, ATM, cards and internet banking operations, and was part of the team that set up DBS's digibank account in India.

speakers.name: Dipayan Chakraborty

Dipayan Chakraborty is Head of the India Analytics Center at eBay in Bengaluru, a role he took up in July 2025. Before eBay he was Partner and Associate Director for AI at Boston Consulting Group (2022 to 2025), Vice President of Data Science and Analytics at Copia Global, Head of Analytics and Business Intelligence at Myntra, where he led a team of about 45 data scientists and analysts and reported to the CEO, and Senior Director of Analytics at Flipkart. Its India Analytics Center in Bengaluru provides data science capabilities to eBay's business teams.

speakers.name: Archana Menon
speakers.title_role: Head of Analytics and Watches, Titan

Archana Menon is Head of Analytics for the Watches division at Titan Company, and also leads the division's AI charter. Menon's remit covers customer acquisition and retention, sales and demand planning, retail network expansion, next-best-action at stores, marketing budget and price optimisation, inventory and product portfolio optimisation and generative AI applications.

Menon joined Titan in 2019 as Analytics Lead for Watches and Wearables, Fragrances and Accessories and Indian ethnic wear, and from 2023 to 2025 set up analytics for Titan's international business in the GCC and North America. Before Titan, Menon was Manager, Analytics at Cognizant (2015-2018), spent five years at Hewlett Packard as an analytics programme manager, and started out as a business technical analyst at Deloitte.

speakers.name: Deepika Sandeep

Deepika Sandeep is Head of the AI/ML Centre of Excellence at HSBC, based in Bengaluru, a role held since January 2025, with a focus on driving adoption of emerging technologies at the bank.

Earlier roles include Manager and Senior Manager, AI and ML, at the renewable energy company Bharat Light & Power (2018-20); advisor for business intelligence and analytics at NTT DATA; data analytics architect at Bosch Global Software Technologies; and research positions at CoreLogic and TCS Research and Innovation.

speakers.name: Anil Varma
speakers.title_role: CTO, Multi Commodity Exchange Clearing Corporation

Anil Varma (Anilkumar Varma) is Chief Technology Officer of Multi Commodity Exchange Clearing Corporation Limited (MCXCCL), the wholly owned clearing subsidiary of MCX and India's first clearing corporation in the commodity derivatives market. He has held the role since November 2021 and is responsible for the clearing corporation's technology, including its move to cloud-native clearing infrastructure, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity and regulatory compliance systems.

Varma has more than 24 years of experience in financial technology and solution architecture. Before MCXCCL he was AVP and Enterprise Technology Architect at National Securities Depository Limited (2018-2021), Deputy General Manager and Solution Architect at Reliance Payment Solutions, working on Jio Payments Bank and JioMoney (2016-2018), Senior Technical Architect at L&T Infotech (2012-2016) and a technical architect at Tata Consultancy Services (2003-2011).

He holds an M.Tech in Computer Software Engineering from BITS Pilani (Work Integrated Learning) and a Post Graduate Diploma in Data Science from NISM. His recognitions include TechCircle's Digital Dynamo award (2025) and CTO of the Year at the NEXTECH Summit and Awards 2026.

speakers.name: Deepak Sharma

At Kotak he set up the NRI banking business, launched the Privy League priority banking programme and, from 2013, led the bank's digital business, including the Kotak 811 digital bank, biometric and video-KYC account opening and its India Stack work on UPI, CBDC and ONDC. He has completed executive programmes at MIT, Stanford Graduate School of Business and IIM Calcutta, and served on CII's Digital Transformation Committee and FICCI's National Committee on Fintech.

Since December 2021 Kishore has led the data and analytics centre of excellence for ITC's FMCG businesses: setting the analytics roadmap, identifying use cases with value estimates, building the data lake, deploying machine-learning solutions in operating processes and measuring business impact.

Kishore has spent more than two decades at ITC, joining in 2000 as Assistant Sales Manager handling FMCG sales and distribution across several states. After a period as Regional Value Chain Manager at Gillette India (2005-2006), Kishore returned to ITC in Kolkata as Divisional Manager, Trade Marketing Information Systems (2006-2010) and then Trade Marketing Information Manager (2010-2021), responsible for channel development, sales technology, process digitisation and business intelligence. Kishore holds a BTech in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Kharagpur and an MBA in Marketing and Operations from IIM Lucknow.
